title: Indian Man Sentenced to Almost 20 Years in Murder-for-Hire Plot on U.S. Soil
summary: Prosecutors said Nikhil Gupta was part of a plot that targeted a number of Sikhs living outside India over their political beliefs.

title: After Brexit, Britain’s Government Floats ‘Breturn’
